capabilities: Size table columns to their content within set minimum and maximum widths
Drag column edges or double-click to fit a column
Persist per-table column widths in an HTML comment above the table or in plugin data
Let wide tables grow into free space beside the readable line width
Style table fonts, sizes and spacing through Style Settings
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and the README says it needs Obsidian 1.14.4 or newer. Widths saved in plugin data cannot be reset yet.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's tables are clean and simple, and I wanted to keep that while adding a little more control.
motivation: The author keeps many notes in tables and missed how tables behave in OneNote, where short columns stay short and column edges can be dragged to a chosen width.
problem: Obsidian tables auto-size their columns, wide tables scroll sideways inside the readable line width, and there is no way to set or remember column widths.

relations.evidence: I missed how tables behave in OneNote
If you use the Style Settings plugin, a Gridlock Tables section lets you change the table font

summary: Table renderer that sizes Markdown table columns to their content, lets wide tables use free pane space, and saves dragged column widths with the note.
